safeProofOptions.name: authoritative_active_children_all_nil
safeProofOptions.precondition: Compact owner metadata fully accounts for every current active particle and proves no nonnil child model. Any nonnil, stale/freed-looking or unknown child fails the proof and retains existing fallback.
safeProofOptions.reason: Native CalculateRadius also inspects only current active child state before this frame's spawn/initialize callbacks. A future custom createChunkModel result is absent from the original pre-simulation radius too.
safeProofOptions.scope: Do not inspect the free pool; it is excluded by original radius. Do not invoke custom child geometry/radius callbacks during this proof.

safeProofOptions.name: canonical_null_model_binding
safeProofOptions.precondition: A canonical chunk_models.no_model binding proves children are null. Resource spelling alone does not prove the behavior of arbitrary custom providers.

safeProofOptions.scope: Preserve nonempty chunkName, chunk-particle type, callbacks, recycling and snapshot semantics; never convert NULL into an empty sprite resource.

preserve: Keep unknown source classification, point-source wind, target/lightning, invalid/negative lifetime and unsupported bounds on conservative fallback.
